title: Dataset provenance artifact (DATA-04 / DATA-05)
$comment: Strict schema for dnallm-mark/data/provenance.json, emitted by script/build_provenance.py from pipeline/datasets_info.json (the D-10 single source of truth). DISCLOSURE (T-06-14 / CONTEXT Area 2): provenance values are research-drafted from public sources (2026-10-11) and were REVIEWED AND ACCEPTED BY THE MAINTAINER on 2026-10-11 (the Task 4 blocking gate resolved - the Unspecified rows stand as accepted honest unknowns); every unresolved license/citation/download cell is the literal string "Unspecified" with the source link in the source field - never a blank (minLength 1 enforces no-empty-string). Corrections flow data/provenance.csv -> script/convert_registry.py --kind provenance --to-json --merge-existing -> re-run make data (the 7-column slice preset; the generic --kind datasets ingest requires the full registry header). The row count is pinned to 50 (the committed benchmark corpus; update deliberately when a dataset is added or retired).

dataset.description: Registry key of the benchmark dataset (Source__task convention).

source.description: Public page naming the dataset's upstream origin (paper DOI, GitHub, or dataset hub page).

citation.description: Upstream paper citation, or the literal Unspecified.

license.description: Dataset license as stated on the hosting page, or the literal Unspecified.

preprocessing.description: How the packaged per-task train/dev/test CSVs were derived from the upstream source.

download_url.description: Primary public download URL (ModelScope mirror where the maintainer org hosts one), or the literal Unspecified.

download_url_alternates.description: Secondary public download URL(s), or the literal Unspecified.
